study: Jaciw, Hegseth et al. 2016 (Math in Focus 'Singapore Math' RCT, Empirical Education / JREE 9(4))
delivery_evidence: HMH National Specialists delivered 5 face-to-face trainings to Clark County MIF teachers (Aug intro 1.5-3h, day-long Sept & Nov grade-level sessions, Jan in-class modeling/debrief, day-long Mar); no online PD component (Training/Professional Development section, pp.9, 33).
test_alignment_evidence: All three included outcomes are off-the-shelf standardized tests not tailored to MIF: SAT-10 Mathematics (Problem Solving, Procedures) and the Nevada state CRT (Tables 16-18, pp.54-57).
curriculum_evidence: PD is tied to adopting Math in Focus, HMH's 'Singapore Math' grades 3-5 CORE math curriculum (textbooks + digital materials); training exists to support implementing that new curriculum ('TPD for curricula'; Intervention/Training section, pp.9, 33).
outcome_timing_evidence: Posttests administered spring 2012 at the end of the single one-year implementation (immediate post-intervention; Tables 16-18, p.54).
